excerpt_zh: 为住宅和商业装修提供室内设计与空间规划，包括 layout 方向、3D 效果图方向、材料建议、施工图协调和装修报价咨询。
excerpt_en: Interior design and space planning for residential and commercial renovation, including layout direction, 3D visualization direction, material advice, drawing coordination, and renovation quotation support.
content_zh: 室内设计不是只挑颜色或摆家具。好的设计应先解决空间动线、收纳、采光、材料搭配、施工可行性和预算优先级。FLASH CAST 可根据确认范围，把空间规划、设计方案、定制家具、材料选择和装修协调衔接起来。 如果同时考虑室内设计与装修，请先提供空间用途、平面图或现场照片，以及想调整的布局、收纳和材料方向。我们会据此讨论设计方向与装修范围如何衔接；图纸、3D 效果图、施工及报价的具体交付，以现场条件和确认范围为准。
content_en: Interior design should clarify layout flow, storage, daylight, material direction, construction feasibility, and budget priorities before renovation begins. FLASH CAST helps owners and business operators connect space planning, design concepts, custom built-in furniture, material selection, and renovation coordination after the scope is confirmed. If you are planning interior design alongside renovation, share the intended use, a floor plan or site photos, and the layout, storage and material priorities you want to review. We can then discuss how the design direction connects with the renovation scope. Specific drawings, 3D visuals, construction work and quotation support depend on site conditions and the scope agreed for your project.

faqs_zh.a: 可沟通动线、收纳、灯光、材料、定制木作、效果图与已确认装修范围的衔接。
faqs_zh.q: 室内设计规划包含哪些内容？

faqs_zh.a: 空间面积、图纸与效果图需求、材料选择、修改范围和协调需求都会影响报价。
faqs_zh.q: 哪些因素会影响室内设计报价？

faqs_zh.a: 可以。概念图会清楚标注为规划参考，不作为真实客户完工项目证明。
faqs_zh.q: 可以先用设计或效果图概念讨论吗？

faqs_zh.a: 提交平面图或现场照片、大致面积、用途、优先需求、地点与计划时间。
faqs_zh.q: 如何开始室内设计咨询？

faqs_zh.a: 先核对空间用途、图纸或现场照片、布局与材料需求，再讨论设计方向、施工范围和报价支持；具体交付按现场条件和确认范围确定。
faqs_zh.q: 室内设计与装修可以怎样衔接？

faqs_en.a: It can cover layout flow, storage, lighting direction, material selection, built-in planning, visualization and coordination with the confirmed renovation scope.
faqs_en.q: What does interior design planning cover?

faqs_en.a: Space size, drawing and visualization needs, material decisions, revision scope and coordination requirements all affect the quotation.
faqs_en.q: What affects an interior design quotation?

faqs_en.a: Yes. Clearly labeled concepts can support planning, but they are not evidence of a completed customer project.
faqs_en.q: Can design or rendering concepts be used for planning?

faqs_en.a: Share a floor plan or site photos, approximate area, intended use, priorities, location and preferred timing.
faqs_en.q: How do I start an interior design enquiry?

faqs_en.a: Start with the intended use, a floor plan or site photos, and layout and material priorities. Then discuss the design direction, renovation scope and quotation support. Specific deliverables depend on site conditions and the agreed scope.
faqs_en.q: How can interior design and renovation be planned together?
